name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 81 - Am 158
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 81 a. Calls for the end of subcontracting within Parliament and for essential services (such as, but not limited to, canteens, cleaning and childcare) to be provided directly in-house from 2026 to better protect precarious workers and ensure decent working conditions;
